description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterResource, which implements a method to unregister a resource type in the Smarty templating engine. It includes a method to remove resource entries from the Smarty object's registry.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterResource
classes.description: Class providing the unregisterResource method to remove template resource types from Smarty's registered resources.

methods.name: unregisterResource
methods.description: Removes a specified resource type from Smarty's registered resources.
